# Plastic Injection Molding

A high-volume manufacturing process that produces parts by injecting molten plastic material into a precision-machined mold. Ideal for creating complex and durable parts with high repeatability.

**Process family:** Injection Molding. Thresholds derived from material properties. Requires a pull direction for draft and undercut analysis.

## What you set up

Before it runs, the analysis asks for:

- **Pull direction**: the direction the mold opens. Pick a face or edge, or an axis.
- **Side actions**: extra directions that slides or lifters move in, if the mold has any.
- **Nominal wall**: the thickness most of the part's walls share. Measured for you, or typed in.

| [Minimum Draft Angle](../rules/min-draft-angle.md) | Critical | Aim for: 1.0° · At least: 0.5° | Not yet sourced |
| [Undercut](../rules/no-undercuts.md) | Critical | If detected: Error | Not yet sourced |
| [Boss Draft](../rules/min-boss-draft.md) | High | Aim for: 1.0° outside (half for the hole) · At least: 0.5° outside (half for the hole) | Not yet sourced |
| [Boss Wall Thickness](../rules/max-boss-wall-ratio.md) | High | Aim for: 60% of nominal wall · At most: 75% of nominal wall | Not yet sourced |
| [Minimum Wall Thickness](../rules/min-wall-thickness.md) | High | Aim for: 1.0 mm · At least: 0.5 mm | Not yet sourced |
